overruns.what_happened: The session ran to 25.21 h against a 14.0 h line. Two things drove it and neither was watched closely enough: the checkpoint export moved 15.4 GB per file at roughly 30 minutes each, and the elapsed clock was not re-checked between the last generation and the export, so the line was already passed before it was noticed.
overruns.what_should_have_happened: The stop line needed an alarm, not a calculation. Every status check recomputed the estimate from the plan instead of reading the instance's own start_date, which is the number that actually moves.
overruns.cost: US$34.27 over the line; cumulative US$102.697 against the US$100 cap

cap_breach.how: The M3 session was authorised to 14.0 h. It ran 25.21 h. The overrun alone is US$34.27, and it is what carried cumulative spend past the cap - before it, accrued was US$25.638 of US$100.
why_it_was_not_caught: Every progress check recomputed a forecast from the plan's per-stage estimates instead of reading the instance's start_date. The forecast stayed reassuring while the clock did not.
The checkpoint export was far slower than assumed - 15.4 GB per file at roughly 30 minutes - and no elapsed-time check ran between the last generation and the export finishing.
tools/experiment_budget.py was only ever invoked before renting. Nothing invoked it during the run, so the one instrument that would have said 'stop' was never asked.
cap_breach.what_the_money_bought: The run itself completed: both training runs, all ten checkpoints converted, 550 generations, and condition 3 met. Nothing was lost. But the milestone's own rule is that spend is capped at US$100, and it was not.
cap_breach.immediate_action: The instance is destroyed and this experiment now burns US$0.00/day.
cap_breach.before_any_further_gpu_work: The cap is the user's decision, not mine to re-authorise. M4 cannot start without an explicit new cap or an explicit exception recorded here.

cap_history.why_superseded: breached at US$102.697; the user raised the cap after the M3 verification retracted the cause diagnosis

cap_raise.what_it_buys: M3-R phase 4: one forward-only pass for the base loss breakdown (US$0.40) and a single V-real re-run (bootstrap + 45 steps + all-epoch export + generation, estimated US$18).
cap_raise.why_v_real_only: The V-tts teacher audio scores 0.7213 against a real-speaker leave-one-out calibration band of 0.8166 (min 0.7405), inside the band in 35 of 80 turns, at comparable durations (7.10s vs 6.77s). That arm's ceiling never reaches the target speaker, so GPU spent on it buys a known null.
cap_raise.preconditions: Phases 0-3 of docs/experiments/j-moshi-tsukuyomi-ojousama-m3r-plan.md are all zero-cost and must pass their gates first. No GPU may be rented before then.
overrun_controls: Fix the stop line as a UTC timestamp, not an elapsed-hours estimate, and read the instance start_date at every check.
Include export time in the estimate; M3 measured roughly 30 minutes per 15.4 GB file.
Invoke tools/experiment_budget.py during the run, not only before renting.

threshold_note: Fractions of experiment_cap (0.75 / 0.90 / 0.95), not absolutes. They were left at the US$100 values when the cap moved to US$125, which made tools/experiment_budget.py return non-zero for every possible plan - a preflight that always says no is one nobody reads. tools/experiment_budget.py holds the same fractions and takes --cap.

preflight_decisions.what_it_buys: base の loss/audio_semantic と loss/audio_semantic_user を分離して実測する。M3 では 10 回計算されながら --with_tracking の内側でしか出ず全部破棄された。acoustic 損失重みが実効 0.99% である事実に対し、重みを触るべきかを推測でなく数値で決める。
preflight_decisions.why_a_cheap_box: forward のみなので optimizer state は不要。fp16 で 15.59 GiB、単一 24GB 級カードに載る。M3 と同じ fp16（ds_configs/zero3-fp16-offload-act_ckpt.json）で測る。
preflight_decisions.host_ram_constraint: finetune.py は CPU 上で fp32 でロードするため 31.19 GiB 必要。RAM 64GB 以上の offer に限定した。

offer_surveys.resolves: 未決3の選択肢(b)（20 GiB 級 1 本で生成と転送を兼ねる）が成立する。所要 4.76 h（生成 1.597 + 転送 2.718 + bootstrap 0.45）で、Tesla P40 なら US$0.508。run1 後の preflight 残余 US$0.897 に収まる（残 US$0.389）。
